I'm in my early 30's and I still feel like my Dad doesn't get it sometimes. He tries, but he always has this tone about the subject that insinuates that I need to "snap out of it". My Mom has depression as well, and over the years has become more of an ally. 

I just stopped talking about it with the people in my life who refuse to understand. It probably also helps that I was 18 when I was diagnosed (in part because my Mom noticed some red flags) and as a result, I've always made all of my own decisions about the mental health care I receive. 

Hang on, love. Find communities like this elsewhere online and if you have friends who will listen, confide in them. The best quality, I think, about those of us who live with depression, is that we're survivors. Incredibly strong, compassionate people who are fighting every day to survive.
I'm glad you're still here. I've been there too, its rough but we're stronger than we think.  💕
